miniProject.title: Audited preferences with independent behavior and rollback evidence
miniProject.brief: Extend `lmlab` in `pref/` with audited comparison data, a bounded reward head and a checked DPO path from the existing SFT checkpoint. Test whether preference optimization changes the study's behavior rather than merely its proxy, length or judge score, using your machine and no paid judge.
steps: Version preference records in `pref/` with generator identities, source-group splits, raw votes, ties and adjudication. Pass TensorTonic canonical-pair cases; retain blinded order/identity/length/style audits and trace a principle-conditioned label's exact principle and judge identity, distinguishing comparison provenance from critique/revision data.

Implement Bradley-Terry likelihood and certify the KL-regularized optimum against independent algebra and TensorTonic policy-objective cases. Before training, retain repeated-vote calibration, offset/scale and separated-vote regressions; test reward-head pooling against last-real-token fixtures, padding changes, identical pairs and partial accumulation windows.

Derive DPO and implement shifted response-only scoring with explicit EOS, padding, empty and truncation rules. Match analytic loss and gradients, TensorTonic DPO cases, pinned RLHF Book scoring/loss code and CS336's tiny-model DPO test; preserve token evidence and reference-identity rejection tests.

Gate training on parameter/FLOP counts and versioned audits: annotator-noise copies, swapped labels, duplicate leakage, mask shifts, wrong normalization and reference mismatch must fail named independent checks. Retain before-and-after regressions; optionally specify an alternative objective contract without requiring another training sweep.

Train or reuse the section's bounded frozen-backbone reward head across seeds. Freeze calibration on separate prompts, then check held-out ranking and probability calibration under generator and length shifts against trusted labels; retain raw scores, shortcut probes, counts and negative or inconclusive evidence.

Compare untouched SFT, chosen-only SFT and DPO with a versioned training-label-noise intervention at matched training and inference budgets across seeds. Use the frozen `eval/` suite and untouched held-out labels; retain independent capability, safety, calibration and diversity outcomes beside margins, proxy rewards and policy drift.

Reproduce the selected comparison from clean state and rebuild `reports/` from raw `registry/` records. Check length/style and judge controls against blinded review; retain paired uncertainty, all candidate-generation, labeling, reference-scoring and failed-run costs, proxy-versus-behavior discrepancies, reduced-scale limits and an owned release or rollback decision.
deliverables: Versioned `pref/` data and label audit, scalar reward head, DPO scorer and objective preflight regressions.
Immutable SFT, reference and preference checkpoints with raw votes, generations, calibration, shift, noise and budget records in `registry/`.
Clean reproduction and independent behavior report with length/style/judge controls, negative evidence and rollback ownership.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Canonicalize Pairwise Preference Data
checks.note: Pass public ranking cases; add tie, duplicate, grouping and label-provenance checks.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Score a KL-Regularized Policy Batch
checks.note: Pass masked-score cases; independently certify the normalized optimum and state its support assumptions.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Implement the DPO Loss
checks.note: Pass public loss cases; add analytic gradients, extreme logits and response-identity swap tests.

checks.name: RLHF Book response scoring and DPOLoss at pinned commit
checks.note: Differential-test frozen-batch scores, loss and gradients with the same completion masks and summed-score convention.

checks.name: CS336 Assignment 5 supplement: tiny-model DPO test
checks.note: Keep course solutions private; the scalar test supplements rather than replaces your mask, gradient and reference regressions.

rubric.pass: Raw votes, adjudication, presentation audits and principle provenance survive conversion; independent likelihood and pooling oracles pass, and held-out calibration and shift reports retain untouched labels and shortcut evidence.
rubric.strong: Offset, scale and separation tests distinguish identification failures from probability errors; disagreements remain traceable to source, rubric, annotator and generator without being erased by adjudication.

rubric.pass: Analytic and pinned-reference loss/gradient tests validate shifted response scoring and DPO; each planted label, leakage, mask, normalization and reference defect fails a named check before training.
rubric.strong: Equal-valued independent score inputs are distinguished from identical responses sharing model parameters, and gradient checks expose defects hidden by initial scalar loss equality.

rubric.pass: Matched multi-seed controls, noise intervention, length/style/judge checks and untouched capability/safety evaluation support a bounded verdict; clean reproduction rebuilds paired outcomes, costs, failed attempts and rollback evidence.
rubric.strong: The report separates proxy fit from behavior, discloses residual budget mismatches and tests the strongest alternative explanation without requiring DPO to win.

miniProject.feedsInto: Audited preference data, reward calibration, frozen references, DPO checkpoints and independent behavior controls feed RL Post-training and Reasoning, safety release analysis and the capstone's versioned post-training comparison.
